card.name: Punctuation just before a date
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a place word right before a month-and-day date, such as the comma after a weekday in a HealthDay dateline or the colon after Appointment. It also fires on the period in abbreviations like Maj.

modes.label: Dateline comma
modes.description: Comma after a weekday that is followed by a month and day in a news dateline.

modes.label: Colon in career records
modes.description: Colon after Appointment or Presentation of Credentials, followed by a date.

modes.label: Abbreviated title period
modes.description: Period after a military title abbreviation, before a name or rank.

card.writes: It promotes abbreviated openers like Sept, Sec, Gen and Univ, and suppresses full titles such as Lieutenant and Professor.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a date or an abbreviated word, like the comma after a weekday in a news dateline.
